dedupe_keys.name: cammesa open data argentina wholesale electricity market demand generation installed capacity fuel use and trade

description: CAMMESA, the company that administers Argentina's wholesale electricity market (Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista, MEM) and dispatches the national grid, publishes monthly market statistics as open data on the Secretaría de Energía portal. Contents: the dataset groups CSV tables for the energy balance, the list of MEM agents, fuel consumption by plants, recent and historical demand, availability by plant, recent and historical generation, imports and exports, and installed capacity (potencia instalada), with links to CAMMESA's own MEMnet publications and operations pages. Coverage: the Argentine interconnected system; the tables are refreshed monthly (demand, historical generation, balance and installed capacity updated 28 September 2026). Format and access: CSV files downloaded from datos.energia.gob.ar; CAMMESA's own site offers more detailed operational reports. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the open tables are monthly aggregates by plant or region, not hourly dispatch; finer data sit in CAMMESA's MEMnet reports, whose terms were not read here. Simulation uses: demand and generation series and plant availability for capacity planning, power system and energy transition models of Argentina, and calibration of outage and hazard studies. Related records: the plant layer (data-argentina-power-plants-centrales-de-generacion) gives the plant locations.
